title: What cat breed am I? Free cat breed personality quiz — cv.cm
description: Free cat breed quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're a Maine Coon, Siamese, Persian, British Shorthair, Bengal, Ragdoll, Sphynx or Russian Blue. No sign-up.
lede: Chatty like a Siamese, laid-back like a Ragdoll or wild like a Bengal? Answer 12 questions about your habits and moods to find the cat breed that matches your personality.
about: Cat breeds are known for different temperaments. Maine Coons are big, friendly gentle giants; Siamese cats are talkative and attached to their people; Persians are calm and love comfort; British Shorthairs are easygoing and independent; Bengals are athletic and endlessly curious; Ragdolls are relaxed and go floppy when you pick them up; Sphynx cats are warm, cheeky and attention-loving; and Russian Blues are gentle, shy with strangers and loyal to their favorite person. This quiz matches your personality with one of these eight.

Your result names your breed and shows your scores for all eight. Every cat is an individual, so think of breed personalities as tendencies, not rules. The quiz is just for fun; if you are choosing a real cat, also think about care, grooming and health, and consider adopting from a shelter. Prefer dogs? Try the dog breed quiz on this site.

faq.a: Maine Coon, Siamese, Persian, British Shorthair, Bengal, Ragdoll, Sphynx and Russian Blue.

faq.q: Is one result rarer than the others?
faq.a: No. Every breed appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

faq.q: Should I pick a cat based on this quiz?
faq.a: No. It matches personalities for fun. A real cat's needs, such as grooming, exercise, space and health, matter much more, and shelters have wonderful cats of every type.

faq.q: Do I need to sign up?
faq.a: No. The quiz is free, and your answers stay in your browser.

mainecoon.name: Maine Coon
mainecoon.body: You are a gentle giant: friendly, easygoing and loyal. You get on with almost everyone, like helping out and are happiest as part of a big, lively household. People feel at home around you.

siamese.name: Siamese
siamese.body: You are talkative, smart and deeply attached to your people. You have opinions and you share them, you hate being ignored and you're fiercely loyal. Life is never boring with you around.

persian.name: Persian
persian.body: You are calm, elegant and fond of comfort. You like things just so, enjoy a quiet, peaceful home and don't need to rush. People find your serenity soothing, and you're more affectionate than you let on.

british.name: British Shorthair
british.body: You are easygoing, steady and independent. You're friendly but don't need constant attention, and you stay calm when others panic. You're the reliable, low-drama friend everyone appreciates.

bengal.name: Bengal
bengal.body: You are energetic, curious and adventurous. You love a challenge, learn fast and get bored if nothing's happening. Keep finding new things to explore; your enthusiasm is contagious.

ragdoll.name: Ragdoll
ragdoll.body: You are relaxed, affectionate and wonderfully laid-back. You go with the flow, love cuddles and make everyone around you feel calmer. Just make sure your easygoing nature doesn't let people walk over you.

sphynx.name: Sphynx
sphynx.body: You are warm, funny and full of personality, and you love being the center of attention. You're affectionate, social and a little mischievous. People can't help smiling around you.

russianblue.name: Russian Blue
russianblue.body: You are gentle, thoughtful and a bit shy with strangers, but deeply loyal to your favorite people. You like routine, quiet and calm. Once someone earns your trust, they have a friend for life.
